newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded Thursday, waiting for London.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded Thursday, waiting for London.

text.p: Brent crude futures were untraded on Thursday and at the close were indicated slightly lower than London's day earlier levels.
July was quoted at the close at $20.07/$20.10 per barrel, after London overnight added 13 cents to settle at $20.13.
Brokers said there was little interest to trade, partly because of some countries being closed owing to national holidays.
In addition, some players are waiting for London to set direction after the run up last week to a two-month high of $20.60 and the subsequent 50-percent retracement.
July NYMEX at the SIMEX close was last traded at $20.80 per barrel, down seven cents from the New York close.

Brokers said they expected the market to remain supported by news of Turkish incursions into Northern Iraq, which is unnerving neighbours. Turkey's state-run news agency Anatolian said Syria, Iraq and Iran were building up forces on the borders of the Kurdish safe-haven in northern Iraq.
